body:
Cut 1.12.0, carrying the in-app update check (T-135).

Minor: new user-facing functionality, and a new API endpoint that only adds. Nothing in
the wire contract, the existing HTTP API or the blueprint mount interface changes, so an
operator upgrading has nothing to do -- though only a server on 1.12.0+ can answer the
update check at all, which is by design (older servers 404 and clients stay quiet).
title: Release 1.12.0
